name: True Scale Mobs
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: SlimeeyYt
description:
MicroMobs makes Minecraft’s world feel more natural and immersive by bringing mob sizes closer to their real-life counterparts.

Tiny insects become truly tiny, animals feel more believable, and the ecosystem becomes more dynamic.
evidence: Not run: Java did not start.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
